sentences.text: Kilocode Oy is a cohort company registered on 2003-07-11 with the industry code 58290, other software publishing.
The register shows first sales on 2003-08-01 and a first hire on 2025-01-03, so it is an established firm rather than a newly formed one.
Recent records include a programme-entry record dated 2026-02-09 and an exhibitor or demo record dated 2026-08-19.
No grant, EU project, public contract or funding record is on file, so the investment level is unknown.
For the fund this stays on the watchlist, and more public evidence on ocean impact and investment readiness is needed before any introduction.
